Lesson 12.2 · 47 of 78 · 24 min · Verified 17 Jul 2026

Legal due diligence and security perfection

After this lesson you can:
  • Separate ownership, title and encumbrance checks
  • Map perfection by asset type
  • Handle exceptions without pretending security exists

Learning rhythm: read one section at a time, pause to explain the control in your own words, then answer the knowledge check without looking back.

On this page
  1. Eligibility before charge
  2. Perfection makes rights effective
  3. Exceptions and satisfaction
  4. Regulatory anchors
  5. Where this lives in LoanOS
  6. Knowledge check

1. Eligibility before charge

Confirm owner and authority, asset identity, existing encumbrances, transfer restrictions and legal enforceability. Property title search, vehicle registration, company charges, warehouse control and receivable assignment use different sources and specialists.

2. Perfection makes rights effective

Execution of a security document is not always enough.

Registration or notation may be needed with CERSAI, ROC, RTO, land registry, depository, insurer or account bank.

Record filing payload, fee, acknowledgement, certificate, rank and deadline.

3. Exceptions and satisfaction

A pending perfection item is a visible condition with expiry, owner and draw/disbursement consequence.

Waivers require authority and compensating control.

Closure reverses the lifecycle through satisfaction, document return and registry evidence — never a simple status edit.

Regulatory anchors

  • CERSAI-CKYC — CERSAI is a central registry anchor for security interests.
  • RBI-IT-GRC — Legal and registry evidence must remain attributable and auditable.

Family IDs resolve in the India regulatory register (docs/compliance/india-regulatory-register.md), which owns sources and caveats.

Knowledge check

Answer aloud or write your choice before opening the explanation. If you miss it, revisit the named section—not the whole lesson.

1. A mortgage deed is signed but mandatory registration is pending. How should it be represented?

  1. Fully perfected
  2. A visible pending perfection condition with gating and escalation
  3. Unsecured forever
  4. Closed
Reveal answer and reasoning

B. Execution and perfection are distinct and the gap must remain explicit.
